scope: Determine whether dispersion, the aromatic C–H···O contact, or entropy/solvation explains the V(+), V(−), and Z conformational balance of SNaft and SAntr, using independent basin searches and paired fixed/relaxed interventions.

species.source: Benchmark identity transcribed from cited structural definition
species.atom_mapping: Integer atom maps identify graph atoms; retain maps across generated coordinates. Add explicit hydrogens deterministically and record their parent map. No reference geometry is supplied.

controls.baseline: R2SCAN/def2-TZVP with documented D3(BJ) switch; vacuum and methanol continuum at 298.15K. Use identical RRHO/quasi-RRHO correction convention (Grimme interpolation 100 cm^-1 baseline) and 1 atm reference throughout; report any 1M conversion separately.
controls.dispersion: For each system/environment evaluate D3-on and D3-off at the same geometries and also relax each from every basin. Fixed-geometry ΔED3 is an electronic control; relaxed ΔG includes geometry/entropy changes.
controls.contact_intervention: For each molecule retain the mapped CSNC/common-core geometry while moving the closest mapped PAH C-H donor away from sulfonyl oxygen; use restrained H···O>=3.5 Å and compare to contact-capable geometry with same restraint budget. Report all changed torsions and restraint energies. This perturbs contact and strain, so is not a pure isolated hydrogen-bond energy.
controls.weights: Normalize only distinct minimum endpoints. Deduplicate merges; constrain no artificial V/Z minimum. Include low-frequency cutoff sensitivity 50 vs100 cm^-1.

source_notes: Main conformational/interactions discussion including C–H···O contact; SI pp8–10 TableS8 vacuum electronic and Gibbs values are distinct reference quantities.
molecular_boundary: Neutral singlet molecules only. Initialize CSNC torsions in V(+) 20–80°, V(−) −80 to −20°, and Z |torsion| 140–180°; these labels are starting basins, not guaranteed distinct minima. Compare free energies only within the same molecule/environment and electronic protocol. C–H···O, not an assumed N–H···O contact, is the source interaction at issue. All required comparisons are core; the optional extension listed below is not a completion condition. A documented failure is a valid submission but is not scientific completion. Evidence-supported collapse of an initialized basin, or inability to distinguish explanations after completing the core matrix, is scientifically admissible. An unattempted core comparison cannot be replaced by an uncertainty statement.
optional_not_required: Different protonation states, charges and antifungal pharmacology must not be mixed into the same ensemble.
